Future<void> optional(rows, [String? cursor]) async {
 for (final row in rows) { cursor = await client.next(row, cursor); }
}
Future<void> run(rows) async {
 final handler = (String? cursor) async {
  for (final row in rows) { cursor = await client.next(row, cursor); }
 };
}
Future<void> named(rows, String? token) async {
 for (final row in rows) { token = await client.push(row, token: token); }
}
Future<void> perPass(rows) async {
 for (final raw in rows) {
  var token = raw;

  token = await client.push(raw, token: token);
 }
}
